ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.23.06 - closes a gap where dealer registration was silently lost when a unit was provisioned over Improv-BLE. /registersave lives on the captive portal, which the device tears down the moment it associates, so a Bluetooth-provisioned unit had nowhere to post the claim. The same NVS-backed claim queue is now exposed as entities - Registration Dealer / Email / Location / Project / EULA Version, Registration EULA Accepted, and a Submit Registration button - so a client can queue the identical claim over the REST or native API. The device still sends it under its own device_token, so the trust model is unchanged. Fields cap at 63 characters to match the claim globals' max_restore_data_length, beyond which a value is silently not persisted. All seven entities are disabled_by_default installer tooling and do not appear in Home Assistant by default.
